note: Rustic Michigan DNR state forest campground on Ski-kwe zaag'igan Lake (the lake and campground were renamed in 2023; formerly Squaw Lake), 15 miles southwest of Republic via M-95, Marquette County; managed from Bewabic State Park. Sites in hardwoods; carry-in, carry-out (no trash barrels). Boat access site on the lake; rainbow trout, splake, bluegill, perch and bass, with good fishing year-round. ORVs may ride between the campground and nearby trails, and all county and state forest roads in the area are open to ORVs. --Claude
summary: DNR page (current name 'Ski-Kwe zaag'igan Lake State Forest Campground', same URL; 'renamed in 2023') + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15 sites, phone 906-875-3324 (all confirmed, derived -> manual); 15-day max (inherited, now stated). Season (closed Nov 1 - May 1) already manual, left. Type 'rustic', not equestrian; the page allows ORVs between the campground and trails (the table's ORV column says 'no') but does not describe an ORV trail camp. 'Tent and small trailer' is the standard wording (silent on length). Directions carry no road warning. Note trimmed of field restatements.
